_comment: Per-talent art slots (one image per listed talent, 73 today). Source of truth for art-pipeline/spec/slots.json together with the scene slots in ./slots. IDs are `SYMBOL/<slot>/<variant>`. Keep ids stable once art exists.

slots.title: Key art portrait
used_in: Stock page header (components/stock/dossier.tsx): right 38% of the header at full header height (≥280), so ~270×340 shown; left edge faded; tablets 55% wide at 50% opacity. Content (name, price, stats) sits to her LEFT

Arcade featured hero, featured talent (components/games/arcade/featured-hero.tsx): up to ~544×680 (48% of the hero width) on the right, bottom ~8% cut off, radial fade from the centre, 55% opacity; phones 120% wide at 40% behind the copy. Copy sits to her LEFT

Card gacha featured hero (components/games/gacha/card-gacha-page.tsx): fills the right stage column (~330×416 contained; ~220×272 on phones), left edge faded, the SSR and UR preview cards overlap its lower centre. Copy sits to her LEFT

Profile banner, the player's oshi (components/profile/profile-view.tsx): right 34% of the banner at full banner height (250–320), so ~200×250 shown; both sides faded, 75% opacity (phones 60% wide at 35%). Name and avatar sit bottom-LEFT
Oshiboard detail header (components/leaderboard/oshiboard-tab.tsx): 150×188, framed
Stocks screener card view (components/stocks/screener.tsx): ~94×118 (72×90 on phones) at the top of each card

Articles index, a story with no picture that tags a talent (components/articles/articles-index.tsx): inside the 16:9 lead box (~600 wide) and the 150×94 row thumbs (96×60 on phones); contained and anchored bottom-centre, so she shows ~94–340 tall
Home HoloNews, same rule (components/home/front-page.tsx): inside the 2:1 lead box and the 72×72 headline thumbs
Card gallery: the talent's page header (planned; the gallery is being built)
Fallback for every card-* slot until the card's own art exists (cover-cropped to 5:7 at 50% 18%: ~5% trimmed from each side)
slots.crop: Waist-up; the waist cut sits ON the bottom edge of the canvas: the figure reaches the bottom edge, and no crop line may fall inside the canvas. The same goes for the sides: if hair or arms are cut by the source frame, the cut must sit on the canvas edge (or be painted out), never float mid-canvas. Consistent scale across all talents (normalised on head size): top of the hair ~8% from the top, eyes 24% (anchor eye_y), chin ~33.5% (this style has a lot of hair above the eyes). Hats, ears and headdresses may run past the top edge and be cut there (reported in anchors.cut). Three-quarter view, body and face turned toward the LEFT of the image: every large placement (stock page, arcade hero, card gacha hero, profile banner, oshiboard) puts her on the right with the text to her left. Small margin above the head / ears / hat. The UI fades the bottom ~25% into the page and scales her up past the box on large placements, so nothing important below the chest. The face must read in a 72px square.
slots.subject: The talent in her main outfit, friendly confident smile, relaxed pose, hands low or out of frame.
slots.lighting: neutral, soft key light from the left; no colored rim light or glow (the UI adds the talent's color behind her)
slots.fallback: ArtSlot placeholder: talent colour wash + halftone + large faded oshimark (the card gacha hero shows nothing instead)
slots.notes: Most reused image on the site: it has to read at 72 px tall (face only) and at 680 px (detail). The arcade hero's radial mask fades everything outside a centred circle, so the face at eye_y 24% sits in the fade ring there (see open question). Twins (FUWAMOCO) share one image and one slot.

slots.title: Reaction set
used_in: Buy/sell fill moment dialog (components/moments/fill-moment.tsx): 168 px column, ≥220 tall (full card width on phones); hype on a buy, smug on a profitable sell, cope on a losing sell
Market floor spotlight (components/market/floor-tab.tsx): right 42% of each spotlight card, ~200 tall; hype for the top gainer, cope for the worst
Market daily report cast (components/market/report-tab.tsx): 112 px (88 on phones); hype for the top of the session, cope for the bottom
Stock page order ticket (components/stock/dossier.tsx): 72 px, idle
Stock page 'In the news' list (components/stock/community-sections.tsx): 64 px, idle, as the thumbnail of an article with no picture
Login / register pitch, today's top mover (components/auth/auth-form.tsx): 96 px, hype, top-right corner over site-auth-pitch; hidden on phones
How to play hero (components/how-to-play/how-to-play-page.tsx): 200 px moon (top gainer) and 168 px shock (rough day)
How to play ticks section (components/how-to-play/sections.tsx): 136 px (104 on phones), hype and cope
Card gallery: the talent's reaction strip (planned; the gallery is being built)

display.css_px: 64 to 200 square (the fill-moment column grows to ~340 on phones)

slots.crop: Waist-up, facing the viewer. Big readable face: head about 45% of the image height, eyes ~36% from the top (anchor eye_y), chin ~49%, hats/ears may be cut at the top edge, so it still reads at 64 px. Hands can enter the frame for the gesture. Centred; the UI anchors the image to the bottom-centre of its box (object-fit contain), so the waist cut must sit ON the bottom edge of the canvas; no crop line inside the canvas. Same head scale for every pose of a talent and across talents.
slots.subject: Same character, same outfit as key art. The expression and gesture carry the meaning; keep every pose cute and in character, never humiliating (fan-work guidelines).
slots.lighting: neutral and soft, identical across all variants; no colored rim light, glow or tint of any kind (the UI adds color). The expression and gesture carry the mood, not the lighting.

variants.name: idle-blink
variants.subject: Exactly the idle image with the eyes closed (same pixels otherwise), for the blink loop.

variants.name: hype
variants.subject: Celebrating a big win: arms up or fist pump, open-mouth grin, sparkles allowed.

variants.name: moon
variants.subject: Pointing up to the sky, excited, 'to the moon' energy. Today only on the how-to-play hero (top gainer).

variants.name: cope
variants.subject: Lost money but coping: nervous smile, sweat drop, thumbs up.

variants.name: smug
variants.subject: Called it: smug grin, half-lidded eyes, hand on chin or arms crossed. Shown on every profitable sell.

variants.name: shock
variants.subject: Something wild happened: wide eyes, hands on cheeks, jaw dropped (cute, not scared). Today only on the how-to-play hero (rough day).

slots.animation: blink: if <pose>-blink exists (only idle-blink is specified) the UI flashes it for ~0.1 s every 4.6 s (CSS, no video)
slots.notes: Replaces the older chibi set: the UI reads v1 manifest chibi.<pose> for these IDs until v2 lands. Same style and proportions as key art so they can sit side by side. P0 poses are the ones the trading flow shows: idle, hype, cope, smug.

slots.title: Card art · C · Standard
used_in: Every talent card (components/games/cards/talent-card.tsx), 30 to 300 px wide: live pull feed 30, arcade side rail 60, arcade tile fans 54–94, showcase strip 96, duel hands and table 92–128, starter pack 132, binder / how-to rarity fan / standard banner fan 150, showcase and trophy shelf 168–236, heroes 176–248, card sheet 300
Pull reveal (components/games/gacha/reveal-stage.tsx): 80–184 in a ten-pull grid, up to 300 for a single pull, 58 in the best-card strip
Card gallery, full size, uncropped (planned; up to ~560 wide)

display.css_px: 30 to 300 wide on cards, up to ~560 in the planned gallery

slots.crop: Full card face, painted edge to edge (cover at 50% 18%, same aspect, so nothing is cropped). The UI covers: a ~2.5% frame on every edge; a top band ~12% tall with the rarity badge at the LEFT and the power badge at the RIGHT; NEW / RATE UP / FEATURED tags on the left just below the rarity badge (to ~22% down); the name plate with oshimark, name, symbol and stars over the bottom ~22% (with a dark text shadow). Put the face between 15% and 45% from the top, centred (eyes ~30%). At 30–60 px only the face and her colours read, so keep the face large.
slots.subject: Waist-up in her main outfit, cheerful, on a simple graphic backdrop in her own colors (soft shapes, her oshimark motif). Clean and readable: the base card everyone owns.
slots.fallback: keyart over the card's CSS rays (then the oshimark placeholder)
slots.notes: The five rarities of one talent are a set: same character, clearly escalating spectacle from C to UR. The planned gallery shows the whole image, so the full frame must be a finished picture.

slots.subject: Her legend: a lore / concept illustration of who she is (use `lore` from talents.overrides.json, e.g. a pirate captain on her ship, a star idol among constellations, a shrine maiden in a festival night). Epic composition, magical effects, the most detailed piece of her set.
slots.lighting: epic and atmospheric, glowing magical light in her colors

variants.name: loop
variants.subject: Same image with subtle motion (particles, hair, light) as a 4 s seamless loop, webm/mp4.

slots.notes: Animated holo frame (CSS) sits on top. This is the image players chase: worth extra candidates and review.

slots.title: Featured banner art
used_in: Card gallery talent page header, 21:9 (16:10 on phones), locked/blurred until the player owns her SSR or UR (games/gallery/gallery-talent.tsx)
Gallery lightbox, full screen (games/gallery/lightbox.tsx)
Card gacha featured hero, full-bleed behind the banner text when this talent is featured and the art exists; otherwise the key art cutout stays (games/gacha/card-gacha-page.tsx)
slots.crop: She stands in the RIGHT 45% of the frame (face in the upper half there). The LEFT 55% stays calm and dark enough for the banner title, rates and pull buttons. Nothing important in the bottom 15% on phones (the image crops to ~4:3 around her).
slots.subject: A wide promotional illustration for her banner: her SSR idol look or her legend setting, reaching toward the viewer, with her signature motifs across the scene.
slots.lighting: promotional: bright key light on her, background falls off into dark ink on the left
slots.fallback: keyart cutout over the banner's blue halftone backdrop (_shared/games-gacha-hero)
slots.notes: Unlocks in the gallery when the player owns her SSR or UR card. Nothing on the site shows this slot today: if the gallery does not use it at launch, drop it to P2.
